meta.promptText: India mein shaadi ke liye budget mein online konsi sarees kharidun?

response.text:
Haan 😊 Agar **shaadi ke liye budget mein online saree** chahiye, toh main fabric aur occasion ke hisaab se ye options recommend karunga:

### [Purple Georgette Silk Buti Banarasi Saree]()
*₹1,599*

### [Banarasee Multicolor Chiffon Saree]()
*₹2,499*

### [Koskii Mauve Organza Gold Saree]()
*₹2,394*

### [Soch Tussar Floral Zari Saree]()
*₹1,999*

### [Banarasee Handwoven Semi-Chiffon Saree]()
*₹2,999*

### 💰 ₹1,000–₹2,500: sabse achha budget
- **Banarasi georgette** — shaadi ke function mein classy lagti hai, halka bhi hota hai.
- **Organza + zari** — reception/mehendi ke liye elegant.
- **Chiffon/semi-chiffon** — comfortable aur photos mein achhi drape.
- **Tussar-look saree with zari** — thoda sophisticated, less “heavy bridal” look.

### 💰 ₹2,500–₹5,000: thoda premium look
Is range mein **better Banarasi/georgette, organza aur handwoven options** dekhna worth it hai. Genuine lightweight Banarasi ke liye Georgette/Kora/Organza realistic choices hain; heavy Katan silk generally is budget se upar hota hai. [thepanaya.com](https://thepanaya.com/blogs/the-panaya/best-banarasi-sarees-under-rs-5000?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Meri personal pick:**  
👉 **Purple/magenta/royal blue Banarasi georgette + contrasting blouse** — ₹1,500–₹3,500 ke aas-paas mein bahut rich look aa sakta hai.

⚠️ ₹500–₹1,000 mein “pure silk Banarasi” likhi saree dikhe toh material zaroor check karna—online marketplaces par is price range mein silk-blend/polyester options bhi bahut hain. [www.myntra.com](https://www.myntra.com/georgette-saree-below-500?f=Type%3ABanarasi&q=georgette-saree-below-500&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Agar aap mujhe **budget (₹1k/₹2k/₹3k/₹5k), bride ho ya wedding guest, aur skin tone** bata do, main **5–7 exact sarees** shortlist karke de sakta hoon.
